verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਫਲ ਦ੍ਰੁੁਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: soraThaa: aadh a(n)t bisamaadh fal dhraum gur sikh sa(n)dh gat ||

en.bdb: Sorath: Just as the puzzle of seed and tree as to who came first is strange and perplexing, similarly strange is understanding the meeting of Guru and Sikh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: aadh param paramaadh a(n)t ana(n)t na jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: This mystery of the beginning and end is beyond comprehension. Lord is beyond, away and infinite.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਫਲ ਦ੍ਰੁੁਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoharaa: fal dhraum gur sikh sa(n)dh gat aadh a(n)t bisamaadh ||

en.bdb: Dohra: Guru Ram Das caused the meeting of Guru and Sikh in the same wondrous way of fruit and tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)t ana(n)t na jaaneeaai aadh param paramaadh ||

en.bdb: That perspective is infinite and no one can understand it. It is beyond, away and still away out of the reach of mortals.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਨਾਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: aadh param paramaadh naadh mil naadh sabadh dhun ||

en.bdb: Channt: Just as the sound of musical instruments melds with the words (of song/hymns), similarly Guru Ram Das and Guru Arjan became indistinguishable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਲਿਲਹਿ ਸਲਿਲ ਸਮਾਇ ਨਾਦ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਨਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: salileh salil samai naadh saritaa saagar sun ||

en.bdb: Just as the river water becomes inseparable from the water of the ocean, Guru Arjan became one with Guru Amar Das by engrossing himself in his precepts and following them obediently.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਹੋਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਰਜਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: narapat sut nirap hot jot gurmukh gun garajan ||

en.bdb: Just as son of a king becomes king, similarly Guru Arjan born as son to Guru Ram Das became an enlightened soul by singing the eulogies of Lord-a boon blessed to him by Satguru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜਨ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: raam naam parasaadh bhe gur te gur arajan ||6||

en.bdb: By the grace of Guru Ram Das, Arjan Dev succeeded him as Guru Arjan Dev.
